description: Erection of rear dormer roof extension and three front roof lights
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed development results in the loss of a traditional pitched roof form in a terrace with an </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">unbroken roofline in a conservation area, hereby reducing the positive qualities and contribution that the application site makes to the conservation area. Furthermore, the rear </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">dormer roof extension, by reason of its size, scale, and detailed design, results in an overly large and obtrusive form of development that fails to respect the character of the host property and the terrace it forms part of. The proposal would neither preserve nor enhance the character and appearance of the Graham Road &amp; Mapledene Conservation Area. As such, the development is contrary to policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), and LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets)&nbsp; </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">of the Hackney LP33 Local Plan (2020), and policies D3 (Optimising site layout through the design-led approach), </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">D4 (Delivering good design) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021) and the guidance contained in the ‘Residential Extensions and Alterations’ SPD (2025). </span></p>
